messages:
Ben Patel: FYI incoming intern Maya K (candidate ID 1234) accepted. Start 2025-06-02. Hiring mgr Elaine asked if we can waive the 30-day waiting period for benefits so health coverage would kick in 2025-06-01. Also Data Infra (sponsor) will cover relocation and wants the stipend treated as one-time outside the comp band. Can people-ops advise routing?

Elaine (Hiring): Candidate only available 6/2 because of a visa appt. Manager would like retroactive coverage 6/1 if possible. Sponsor will sign funding note.

Adrian Gomez: Confirming Data Infra will pay relocation + one-time sign-on stipend. We can sign whatever form needed. We don't want this to impact Maya's comp band if she converts.

Sophie Chen: Quick policy note: interns default to a 30-day waiting period for core benefits. Exceptions are rare and require Total Comp + Legal signoff. For stipend treatment we need a comp exception to mark it non-recurring. Please submit the Benefits Exception Request form and attach a signed sponsor funding note. Route to total-comp@redwood.com and cc people-ops.

Ben Patel: Ok I'll submit. Quick Q — is there a preferred template for the manager justification?

Amy O'Neil: @Ben use this wording and attach the supporting docs when you submit:
```
Subject: Benefit & Comp Exception Request — Maya K (Intern)
Candidate: Maya K (email: maya.k@example.com)
Start: 2025-06-02 (candidate availability)
Requested coverage: Retroactive medical start 2025-06-01
Sponsor funding: Data Infra (Adrian Gomez) covers relocation and one-time stipend $2,500
Business rationale: critical summer project timeline; candidate constrained by visa appointment
Approvals requested: Total Comp, Legal, People Ops
Supporting docs: signed sponsor funding note, offer letter, candidate availability email
```

Elaine (Hiring): Sending this to the manager + attaching sponsor note now. Thanks.

OnboardBot: Benefits Exception Request form submitted by Ben Patel at 2025-05-05 16:12 UTC (Form ID: BE-2025-889).

Sophie Chen: Got the form and docs, thanks. I'll escalate to Total Comp and Legal (48h SLA). If approved we'll backdate coverage to 2025-06-01 and mark the stipend as a one-time non-recurring payment for comp-banding purposes.

Ben Patel: Uploaded signed pdf to the form. :thumbsup:

Adrian Gomez: Happy to sign/confirm anything else you need.

Sophie Chen: Appreciate it. I'll update this thread when Total Comp or Legal respond. If Legal requests language changes we'll loop in the manager for signoff.
